anything.definition: used to refer to any thing or amount, no matter what

everything.definition: all things; the whole of what is being discussed

everyone.definition: every person; all the people in a group

per.definition: for each one (used with a rate or measurement, e.g. 'per day')

others.definition: other people or things not already mentioned

else.definition: other than what has already been mentioned

whether.definition: used to introduce a choice or doubt between two possibilities

among.definition: surrounded by, in the middle of, or included within a group

myself.definition: used by a speaker to refer to themselves as the object of their own action

yourself.definition: used to refer to the person spoken to as the object of their own action

gonna.definition: informal short form of 'going to' (used before a verb to show future intention)

himself.definition: used to refer to a male previously mentioned as the object of his own action

dr.definition: abbreviation for 'doctor', a title used before a person's name

themselves.definition: used to refer to people or things previously mentioned as the object of their own action

hey.definition: used to attract attention or to express surprise, interest, or greeting

upon.definition: on, or immediately after (a more formal word for 'on')

cannot.definition: not able to; the negative form of 'can'

itself.definition: used to refer to a thing previously mentioned as the object of its own action

lol.definition: internet slang for 'laughing out loud', used to show something is funny

etc.definition: abbreviation for 'et cetera', meaning 'and other similar things'

shall.definition: used to express what will happen or what someone is obliged to do (formal)

via.definition: by way of, through, or using
